cue: You were sure you'd left your passport at the hotel, then you find it in your coat pocket at the airport.

ctx.s: 迷子[まいご]の子[こ]どもが無事[ぶじ]に見[み]つかって、{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろした}。
ctx.en: The lost child was found safe, and I breathed a sigh of relief.

ctx.s: 検査[けんさ]の結果[けっか]が異常[いじょう]なしと聞[き]いて、ほっと{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろした}。
ctx.en: When I heard the test results were normal, I felt hugely relieved.

ctx.s: 乗[の]り遅[おく]れたと思[おも]った電車[でんしゃ]がまだ来[き]ていなくて、{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろした}。
ctx.en: I thought I'd missed the train, but it hadn't come yet. What a relief.

ctx.s: 台風[たいふう]がそれたというニュースに、島[しま]の人々[ひとびと]は{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろした}。
ctx.en: The islanders were relieved by the news that the typhoon had changed course.

ctx.s: 消[き]えたと思[おも]ったデータが見[み]つかり、担当者[たんとうしゃ]は{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろしている}。
ctx.en: The data they thought was lost has been found, and the person in charge is relieved.

ctx.s: 「けが人[にん]が出[で]なかったことに、まずは{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろしています}」と市長[しちょう]は語[かた]った。
ctx.en: "First of all, I'm relieved that no one was hurt," the mayor said.

bad.s: 温泉[おんせん]に入[はい]って、のんびり{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろした}。
bad.en: (meant: I soaked in the hot spring and relaxed)
bad.why: It is relief after a worry is lifted, not relaxation. For unwinding, say nonbiri shita or kutsuroida.

bad.s: 泣[な]いている子[こ]どもの{胸[むね]をなで下[お]ろして}あげた。
bad.en: (meant: I soothed the crying child)
bad.why: It is only about your own relief, never soothing someone else. To comfort a child, say senaka o sasutte ageta.
